-- ââ The frame: the era layout, 28+144+28 wide, 32 top, 28 bottom, 7 rungs of 21 and -- three gaps of 20 âââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââ GameMenuFrame:SetWidth(200) GameMenuFrame:SetHeight(288)
-- The stock title (`GameMenuFrame.xml:36`) has no name: found as addons find it. for _, region in ipairs({ GameMenuFrame:GetRegions() }) do if region:GetObjectType() == "FontString" and region:GetText() == MAIN_MENU then region:SetFontObject(BenillaGameFontNormalMed1) end end
-- BENILLA_ERA_WINDOW_SCALE (OptionsFrame.xml) stands in for the era's UIParent scale; -- read at every show, then the stock OnShow. local Ref_GameMenuFrame_OnShow = GameMenuFrame:GetScript("OnShow") GameMenuFrame:SetScript("OnShow", function() this:SetScale(BENILLA_ERA_WINDOW_SCALE or 1) Ref_GameMenuFrame_OnShow() end)
-- ââ The rungs âââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââ -- Every stock rung stays, anchored TOP to a BOTTOM as in the stock file, so an addon's -- `SetPoint("TOP", â¦)` replaces its one anchor. The three the era menu lacks are hidden -- in place, with Sound and UI Options each laid over the rung above it, so they take no -- space: a width or height of 0 is no size in 1.12's layout, not a flat rect.
-- Literal: 1.12 has no GAMEMENU_OPTIONS; its OPTIONS_MENU is "Options Menu". GameMenuButtonOptions:SetText("Options") GameMenuButtonOptions:ClearAllPoints() GameMenuButtonOptions:SetPoint("TOP", GameMenuFrame, "TOP", 0, -32) GameMenuButtonOptions:SetScript("OnClick", function() PlaySound("igMainMenuOption") HideUIPanel(GameMenuFrame) ShowUIPanel(BenillaOptionsFrame) end)
for _, fold in ipairs({ { GameMenuButtonSoundOptions, GameMenuButtonOptions }, { GameMenuButtonUIOptions, GameMenuButtonSoundOptions }, }) do local button, above = fold[1], fold[2] button:Hide() button:ClearAllPoints() button:SetPoint("TOP", above, "BOTTOM", 0, button:GetHeight()) end -- Key Bindings keeps its stock anchor, 1 under UI Options: the era rungs hang from its -- top, so an addon that inserts a button above it and re-anchors it under that button -- (ShaguTweaks) moves them down as it moves the stock rungs. GameMenuButtonKeybindings:Hide()
-- The era's Edit Mode and Support, with nothing behind them yet: disabled. local editMode = CreateFrame("Button", "BenillaGameMenuButtonEditMode", GameMenuFrame, "GameMenuButtonTemplate") editMode:SetPoint("TOP", GameMenuButtonKeybindings, "TOP", 0, -19) editMode:SetText("Edit Mode") editMode:Disable() local support = CreateFrame("Button", "BenillaGameMenuButtonSupport", GameMenuFrame, "GameMenuButtonTemplate") support:SetPoint("TOP", editMode, "BOTTOM", 0, 0) support:SetText("Support") support:Disable()
GameMenuButtonMacros:SetPoint("TOP", support, "BOTTOM", 0, 0)
local addonsBtn = CreateFrame("Button", "BenillaGameMenuButtonAddons", GameMenuFrame, "GameMenuButtonTemplate") addonsBtn:SetPoint("TOP", GameMenuButtonMacros, "BOTTOM", 0, 0) addonsBtn:SetText("AddOns") addonsBtn:SetScript("OnClick", function() PlaySound("igMainMenuOption") HideUIPanel(GameMenuFrame) BenillaAddonList_Show() end)
GameMenuButtonLogout:SetPoint("TOP", addonsBtn, "BOTTOM", 0, -20) GameMenuButtonQuit:SetPoint("TOP", GameMenuButtonLogout, "BOTTOM", 0, 0) GameMenuButtonContinue:SetPoint("TOP", GameMenuButtonQuit, "BOTTOM", 0, -20)
-- ââ Our options window in the stock "is an options window open?" checks âââââââââââââââ -- Each wraps the stock function to add `BenillaOptionsFrame` and `BenillaAddonListFrame`. local Ref_IsOptionFrameOpen = IsOptionFrameOpen local Ref_ToggleGameMenu = ToggleGameMenu local Ref_UpdateMicroButtons = UpdateMicroButtons
-- Guarded for a test kit that loads the game menu without the options window. local function BenillaOptions_IsOpen() return (BenillaOptionsFrame and BenillaOptionsFrame:IsVisible()) or (BenillaAddonListFrame and BenillaAddonListFrame:IsVisible()) end
-- `UIParent.lua:996`: a yes keeps the ESC sweep off the centre panel, which our window is. function IsOptionFrameOpen() if BenillaOptions_IsOpen() then return 1 end return Ref_IsOptionFrameOpen() end
-- `UIParent.lua:1465-1497`: static popup, then an open options window, then the stock -- ladder. Our Close click is the discard-and-hide of the reference's `OptionsFrameCancel`. function ToggleGameMenu(clicked) if clicked then -- As the reference's `clicked` arm: close an options window, then toggle. if BenillaOptions_IsOpen() then if BenillaAddonListFrame and BenillaAddonListFrame:IsVisible() then BenillaAddonListFrame:Hide() elseif BenillaOptionsFrameCloseButton then BenillaOptionsFrameCloseButton:Click() end end return Ref_ToggleGameMenu(clicked) end if StaticPopup_EscapePressed() then return end if BenillaOptions_IsOpen() then if BenillaAddonListFrame and BenillaAddonListFrame:IsVisible() then BenillaAddonListFrame:Hide() elseif BenillaOptionsFrameCloseButton then BenillaOptionsFrameCloseButton:Click() end return end return Ref_ToggleGameMenu(clicked) end
-- `MainMenuBarMicroButtons.lua:47-58`: only ever pushes the button, so the stock decision -- stands and ours adds our window. Guarded for a test kit that loads no micro buttons. function UpdateMicroButtons() if Ref_UpdateMicroButtons then Ref_UpdateMicroButtons() end if MainMenuMicroButton and BenillaOptions_IsOpen() then MainMenuMicroButton:SetButtonState("PUSHED", 1) end end
-- ââ Benilla AddOn Manager Logic ââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââ UIPanelWindows["BenillaAddonListFrame"] = { area = "center", pushable = 0, whileDead = 1 } table.insert(UISpecialFrames, "BenillaAddonListFrame")
function BenillaAddonList_Show() if not BenillaAddonListFrame then return end ShowUIPanel(BenillaAddonListFrame) BenillaAddonList_Update() end
function BenillaAddonList_Toggle() if not BenillaAddonListFrame then return end if BenillaAddonListFrame:IsVisible() then HideUIPanel(BenillaAddonListFrame) else BenillaAddonList_Show() end end
SLASH_BENILLAADDONS1 = "/addons" SLASH_BENILLAADDONS2 = "/addon" SlashCmdList["BENILLAADDONS"] = function() BenillaAddonList_Toggle() end
function BenillaAddonList_Update() if not BenillaAddonListFrame then return end local count = GetNumAddOns() if not BenillaAddonListFrame.offset then BenillaAddonListFrame.offset = 0 end local maxOffset = math.max(0, count - 14) if BenillaAddonListFrame.offset > maxOffset then BenillaAddonListFrame.offset = maxOffset end if BenillaAddonListFrame.offset < 0 then BenillaAddonListFrame.offset = 0 end
-- Force load checkbox local forceBox = getglobal("BenillaAddonListFrameForceLoad") if forceBox then local check = GetCVar("checkAddonVersion") forceBox:SetChecked(check == "0") end
for i = 1, 14 do local row = getglobal("BenillaAddonListEntry" .. i) local idx = BenillaAddonListFrame.offset + i if row then if idx <= count then row.addonIndex = idx local name, title, notes, enabled, loadable, reason, security = GetAddOnInfo(idx) local check = getglobal(row:GetName() .. "Check") local titleText = getglobal(row:GetName() .. "Title") local statusText = getglobal(row:GetName() .. "Status")
check:SetChecked(enabled and enabled == 1) titleText:SetText(title or name)
if loadable then titleText:SetTextColor(1.0, 0.82, 0.0) elseif enabled and reason ~= "DEP_DISABLED" then titleText:SetTextColor(1.0, 0.2, 0.2) else titleText:SetTextColor(0.55, 0.55, 0.55) end
if IsAddOnLoaded(idx) then statusText:SetText("Loaded") statusText:SetTextColor(0.2, 1.0, 0.2) elseif IsAddOnLoadOnDemand(idx) then statusText:SetText("On Demand") statusText:SetTextColor(0.5, 0.8, 1.0) elseif not enabled then statusText:SetText("Disabled") statusText:SetTextColor(0.5, 0.5, 0.5) elseif reason then statusText:SetText(getglobal("ADDON_" .. reason) or reason) statusText:SetTextColor(1.0, 0.2, 0.2) else statusText:SetText("Enabled") statusText:SetTextColor(1.0, 0.82, 0.0) end
row:Show() else row.addonIndex = nil row:Hide() end end end
local scrollBar = getglobal("BenillaAddonListScrollBar") if scrollBar then scrollBar:SetMinMaxValues(0, maxOffset) scrollBar:SetValue(BenillaAddonListFrame.offset) if maxOffset > 0 then scrollBar:Show() else scrollBar:Hide() end end end
function BenillaAddonList_ApplyProfile(profile) local count = GetNumAddOns() for i = 1, count do local name = GetAddOnInfo(i) local shouldEnable = false if profile == "classicplus" then shouldEnable = (name == "Questie" or name == "Cartographer" or name == "ClassicCastbars" or name == "OmniCC" or name == "Bagnon" or name == "Aux" or name == "Postal" or name == "VoiceOver") elseif profile == "purist" then shouldEnable = (name == "ClassicCastbars" or name == "OmniCC") elseif profile == "raider" then shouldEnable = (name == "Questie" or name == "Cartographer" or name == "ClassicCastbars" or name == "OmniCC" or name == "Bagnon" or name == "Aux" or name == "Postal" or name == "VoiceOver" or name == "ClassicThreatMeter" or name == "LunaUnitFrames" or name == "BigWigs" or name == "DPSMate" or name == "Clique" or name == "ItemRack") end if shouldEnable then EnableAddOn(i) else DisableAddOn(i) end end PlaySound("igMainMenuOptionCheckBoxOn") BenillaAddonList_Update() end

Scripts.OnClick: local parent = this:GetParent() if parent.addonIndex then if this:GetChecked() then EnableAddOn(parent.addonIndex) else DisableAddOn(parent.addonIndex) end BenillaAddonList_Update() end

Scripts.OnEnter: local parent = this:GetParent() if parent.addonIndex and parent.addonIndex <= GetNumAddOns() then local name, title, notes, enabled, loadable, reason, security = GetAddOnInfo(parent.addonIndex) GameTooltip:SetOwner(this, "ANCHOR_RIGHT") GameTooltip:AddLine(title or name, 1, 0.82, 0) if notes and notes ~= "" then GameTooltip:AddLine(notes, 1, 1, 1, 1) end local author = GetAddOnMetadata(parent.addonIndex, "Author") if author then GameTooltip:AddDoubleLine("Author:", author, 0.7, 0.7, 0.7, 1, 1, 1) end local version = GetAddOnMetadata(parent.addonIndex, "Version") if version then GameTooltip:AddDoubleLine("Version:", version, 0.7, 0.7, 0.7, 1, 1, 1) end local deps = { GetAddOnDependencies(parent.addonIndex) } if deps and table.getn(deps) > 0 then GameTooltip:AddLine("Dependencies: " .. table.concat(deps, ", "), 0.7, 0.7, 0.7, 1) end GameTooltip:Show() end

Scripts.OnClick: if this:GetChecked() then SetCVar("checkAddonVersion", "0") else SetCVar("checkAddonVersion", "1") end BenillaAddonList_Update()

Scripts.OnValueChanged: local val = math.floor(arg1 + 0.5) if val ~= BenillaAddonListFrame.offset then BenillaAddonListFrame.offset = val BenillaAddonList_Update() end

Scripts.OnClick: local count = GetNumAddOns() for i = 1, count do DisableAddOn(i) end PlaySound("igMainMenuOptionCheckBoxOff") BenillaAddonList_Update()
local count = GetNumAddOns() for i = 1, count do EnableAddOn(i) end PlaySound("igMainMenuOptionCheckBoxOn") BenillaAddonList_Update()
if SaveAddOns then SaveAddOns() end ReloadUI()
if SaveAddOns then SaveAddOns() end HideUIPanel(this:GetParent())

Scripts.OnMouseWheel: local cur = BenillaAddonListFrame.offset or 0 if arg1 > 0 then BenillaAddonListFrame.offset = math.max(0, cur - 1) else local maxOffset = math.max(0, GetNumAddOns() - 14) BenillaAddonListFrame.offset = math.min(maxOffset, cur + 1) end BenillaAddonList_Update()
